stem: Why did the U.S. Senate refuse to ratify the Treaty of Versailles after World War I?

options.label: F
options.text: The Senate would not support America’s participation in the League of Nations.

options.label: G
options.text: The Senate believed the treaty did not punish Germany enough.

options.label: H
options.text: The Senate thought the treaty did not have the power to prevent secret alliances.

options.label: J
options.text: The Senate could not agree on military disarmament levels.
